author: NASASpaceflight
description:
SpaceX had one of the strangest Starship testing weeks we've seen in quite some time.

Ship 40 and Ship 41 repeatedly swapped places between the Production Site and Massey's Test Site as SpaceX worked through an unusual series of cryogenic tests and static fires. After completing a full 60-second six-engine static fire, Ship 40 now appears to be entering its final preparations for Starship Flight 13.

Meanwhile, Ship 41 returned to the Production Site after completing almost no visible testing, raising new questions about SpaceX's test campaign.

We also cover:

🚀 Booster 22 stacking progresses at record pace
🚀 Ship 42 begins stacking inside Mega Bay 2
🚀 Gigabay construction reaches its final levels
🚀 New Starfactory hardware
🚀 Roberts Road construction update
🚀 LC-39A continues toward operational readiness
🚀 SLC-37 construction progress
🚀 Pad 2 deluge testing and catch rehearsals
🚀 McGregor Raptor engine production

Could Flight 13 be just around the corner?
